import sys

def main():
    for s in sys.stdin.read().split():
        out = [s[0]]
        i = 1
        at_done = False
        while i < len(s):
            if not at_done and i + 1 < len(s) and s[i] == 'a' and s[i+1] == 't':
                out.append('@')
                at_done = True
                i += 2
            elif i + 2 < len(s) and s[i] == 'd' and s[i+1] == 'o' and s[i+2] == 't':
                out.append('.')
                i += 3
            else:
                out.append(s[i])
                i += 1
        print(''.join(out))

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
